description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2070/48, Kesbewa D/S Division,  and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing corrections to parcel numbers, land extents, owner names, and village designations for multiple land parcels. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
